I should clarify: having any of the above-described tendencies does not make you a Diminisher; it simply increases the likelihood that you will have a diminishing impact. That’s the good news. The bad news is that when you have a diminishing impact, you are likely to be completely unaware of it and probably the last to know. As a leader, how do you know whether you are having a diminishing effect, despite having the best intentions? How do you increase your self-awareness? Formulating and recording your own insights is a reasonable first step, but you’ll learn more by asking the people you lead to share their insights.
